verdict.rationale: A state business-filing portal could plausibly offer a public API, so this axis applies. The evidence shows only web UI workflows (online filing wizards, entity search, PDF downloads, an authorized-user UCC e-filing system), and probes found no OpenAPI spec, no llms.txt, and no documented public API on the agency's hosts. There is therefore no evidence of API parity with the UI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
